aboutPage.heroDesc: Authorized overseas sample factory of Shanghai WISER Machinery Co., Ltd. and strategic partner of Sidefu Linen, delivering turnkey industrial laundry excellence worldwide.
aboutPage.sec1Desc: Established in Shanghai, China, Shanghai WISER Machinery Co., Ltd. is a premier manufacturer of industrial laundry systems, soft-mount high-extract washers, chest flatwork ironers, and automatic folders with CE, ISO 9001, and ISO 14001 certifications.
aboutPage.sec1Point2: Microcomputer Smart PLC touchscreen with 30+ programmable formulas
aboutPage.sec1Point3: Heavy-gauge SUS 304/316L stainless steel inner and outer drums
aboutPage.sec1Point4: Direct steam, thermal oil, and electric high-efficiency heating systems
aboutPage.sec2Desc: Founded in 1984, Sidefu is one of the world's most prestigious luxury hotel linen manufacturers, serving top global brands including Marriott, Hilton, InterContinental, Hyatt, and Kempinski with OEKO-TEX 100 Class 1 certified textiles.
aboutPage.sec2Point1: 100% Long-Staple Combed Cotton (300T to 1000T Sateen & Percale)
aboutPage.sec2Point2: OEKO-TEX Standard 100 Class 1 certification (Safe for infant skin)
aboutPage.sec2Point3: Engineered for 300+ commercial wash durability without fiber degradation
aboutPage.sec2Point4: Complete guest room sets: Bed sheets, duvet covers, plush towels & bathrobes
aboutPage.timeline1Desc: Establishment of dedicated manufacturing plant in Shanghai focusing on heavy-duty commercial laundry equipment.
aboutPage.timeline2Desc: Full compliance achieved for EU Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC and international quality management standards.
aboutPage.timeline3Desc: Alliance forged with Sidefu China to provide turnkey synchronized equipment and luxury linen solutions.
aboutPage.timeline4Desc: WISER ACC establishes modernized overseas demonstration and engineering support facilities for international clients.

solutionsPage.heroTitle: Turnkey Laundry Solutions for Every Scale
solutionsPage.heroDesc: From on-premise luxury resort laundries to 30-ton/day automated industrial central plants and healthcare-certified cleanroom bio-barriers.
solutionsPage.sol1Desc: Custom in-house plant layouts engineered for 200–1,000+ guest rooms. Combines soft-mount washers, high-speed chest ironers, and Sidefu 800T luxury linens to reduce linen replacement costs while guaranteeing plush guest satisfaction.
solutionsPage.sol1Feat1: Synchronized 350G washer extractors and energy-efficient tumble dryers
solutionsPage.sol1Feat2: Mirror-polished chest flatwork ironer for pristine sheet finishes
solutionsPage.sol1Feat3: OEKO-TEX 100 certified Sidefu 600T–800T combed cotton linens
solutionsPage.sol1Feat4: Complete CAD pipe routing, steam boiler integration & chemical dosing layout
solutionsPage.sol2Desc: Hermetically sealed pass-through washer extractors designed to separate dirty intake rooms from sterile cleanroom pack-out areas, meeting strict ISO 14644-1 and European hospital disinfection norms.
solutionsPage.sol2Feat1: Dual-door physical partition barrier isolating contaminated and clean zones
solutionsPage.sol2Feat2: Automated thermal disinfection cycle maintaining 90°C+ wash profiles
solutionsPage.sol2Feat3: SUS 316L acid/alkali-resistant medical grade stainless steel inner drums
solutionsPage.sol2Feat4: HEPA-filtered cleanroom tumble dryers and hygienic bagging dispatch
solutionsPage.sol3Desc: Automated high-throughput washing and finishing lines for commercial linen rental companies and regional laundry plants, engineered with heat exchangers and water recycling systems to slash operating utility bills.
solutionsPage.sol3Feat1: Heavy-duty 100kg washer extractor batteries with pneumatic tilt unloading
solutionsPage.sol3Feat2: Multi-roll gas/steam flatwork ironers paired with 4-lane high-speed folders
solutionsPage.sol3Feat3: Integrated wastewater heat recovery reducing steam consumption up to 40%
solutionsPage.sol3Feat4: Centralized RFID tracking and plant-wide SCADA automation monitoring
